points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: says use formal SMW200A/FSW specs and cites versions, but not every claim/version or missing-version rule

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions formal specs/configuration evidence, but omits test conditions, no unit conversion, and no option-inference rule

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: missing
points.why: does not distinguish warranted specs from typ./nom./meas./n. trc. or ban typical-value comparisons

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: covered
points.why: states FSW data without tolerance limits is not binding and specs may change

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: partial
points.why: requires formal competitor sources, but omits third-party evidence, single-source internal caveat, and customer-document context

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: covered
points.why: says sales-positioning competitor pages are not binding technical specifications

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: partial
points.why: says battle-card numbers need formal competitor sources, but does not list missing datasheet/version/order/option/release/test conditions

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: partial
points.why: notes A&D and SG/SA evidence is not tied together, but omits sales-mapping-not-test-configuration rule and required follow-up documents
